saints.name: All Saints
saints.title: Solemnity of All the Saints
saints.shortBlurb: The Church's great feast of all the blessed in heaven, known and unknown, who share the vision of God…
biography: On this solemnity the Church honours the whole company of the saints in glory — not only those named in her calendar, but the countless multitude of the redeemed whom no one can number, drawn from every nation and age. The feast celebrates the communion of saints, the bond of prayer and charity uniting the pilgrim Church on earth with the Church triumphant in heaven.

A commemoration of all the martyrs was kept in Rome from early centuries; Pope Boniface IV dedicated the Pantheon to Our Lady and all the martyrs in the seventh century, and Pope Gregory IV is traditionally said to have fixed the general feast on 1 November in the ninth century, whence it spread throughout the Western Church.
saints.knownFor: Honouring the whole multitude of the blessed in heaven.
